resources.string: This app adds the ML Kit translation engine to YEONFEEL Keyboard. To use it, choose ML Kit as the translation engine in the keyboard\'s translation settings.
Translation runs on this device. The network is only used to download language models (about 30 MB each), and YEONFEEL Keyboard downloads them over Wi-Fi only.
No language models downloaded yet. They are downloaded the first time you translate a language.
Delete the %1$s language model? It will be downloaded again the next time you translate this language.
